chunks.title: vacation
chunks.text: The annual allowance is 20 days, accrued monthly, and up to 5 unused days carry into the next year.

chunks.title: sick
chunks.text: The annual allowance is 10 days; unused days are forfeited at the end of the year and do not carry over.

chunks.title: remote
chunks.text: This is permitted up to 3 days per week; a fully flexible arrangement requires manager sign-off.

chunks.title: office
chunks.text: Attendance on-site is expected at least 2 days each week for every team member.

chunks.title: expenses
chunks.text: Claims must be filed within 30 days; payouts are issued on the 15th of the following month.

questions.q: How many paid vacation days do employees get?
How many sick days are provided each year?
How many days a week can I work remotely?
How often must I be physically present in the office?
